# Copilot guidance

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository rules and [the live native-pipeline index](../docs/development/README.md) for `open-RT` ownership.

Preserve `CommunityShaders` runtime compatibility, upstream attribution and all licenses. Keep modifications narrow, feature toggles independent, DX11 capture distinct from native DX12 execution, and per-frame resource/fence ownership safe. Do not claim native-only presentation or successful runtime testing based solely on source code. Make no force pushes or unrelated release changes.
